uv_memory.scope: 14 actual UV/curve/numerical production units; isolated ASan invalid-access and Debug CRT retained-block/allocation-hook coverage. Not full application, LSan, UBSan or arbitrary exception safety.

previous_node_boundary.scope: Isolated actual physical node/submesh/triangle production sources; no whole-application or UBSan/LSan qualification.

curve_memory.scope: Seven actual curve/point/patch/numerical production units; observer collection replacement and two pointer-taking copy constructors. ASan invalid-access and Debug CRT scoped retention/allocation denial; not full application, derived curves, LSan, UBSan or arbitrary exception safety.

copy_memory.scope: Nine actual curve/point/patch/numerical production units. Initialized non-null pointer-taking copies, independent containers and borrowed-object lifetimes; ASan invalid-access and Debug CRT scoped retention/allocation denial. Not implicit copy/assignment, clone publication, full application, parallel, LSan or UBSan.

copy_comparison.allocation_behavior: Populated copies allocate additional parameter nodes; no portable-count or performance promise.
